welcome.title: Welcome to SaaS Complete Setup
welcome.description: Let's configure your application in just a few steps. This wizard will help you set up environment variables, database connection, Stripe integration, and generate your landing page.

items.title: Environment Variables
items.description: Configure Supabase, email services, AI integration, and other essential API keys

items.title: Database Setup
items.description: Test database connection and push your schema to Supabase PostgreSQL

items.title: Stripe Configuration
items.description: Create products, set pricing, configure webhooks, and sync everything to Stripe

items.title: Landing Page
items.description: Auto-generate a minimal landing page with your branding and pricing

prerequisites.title: Before You Start
items: Have a Supabase project created with database URL and API keys
Have a Stripe account (test mode is fine for now)
Optional: Resend API key for email, OpenRouter key for AI chat
